text:
jamal: @here urgent hotfix for auth token expiry affecting web and mobile sign-ins. Need expedited approvals to pin image and run canary. Impact: intermittent token refresh failures ~1% of requests. No DB/schema changes. Rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 500ms. Target change window: immediate, expected 30–45m. Tagging @ellie (security), @sara (product), @miguel (oncall ops).

ellie: security quick check: no new secrets, no creds rotated, binary diff OK. security approves emergency deploy :white_check_mark:.

sara: product approves fast-track. Please add a short customer note and ping support when canary looks good.

miguel: oncall here. I'll run a 3-node canary at low qps (50rps) for 10m, watch errors, p50/p95, CPU and tail latency. If anything tripped I'll abort and rollback.

jamal: executing canary deploy. command:```/deploy prod --image redwood/api:2.3.1-hotfix --pin-version --strategy canary --canary-instances 3 --canary-duration 10m --notify "eng-releases, support"```

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy for redwood/api:2.3.1-hotfix (initiated by jamal). Canary: 3 instances. Observability hooks: /dashboards/service/auth, /alerts/auth-5xx.

miguel: canary started at 23:10 UTC. linking dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/auth-overview

miguel: canary 5m update — errors 0.01%, p95 215ms (baseline p95 200ms), cpu avg 62%. No client-facing errors observed.

jamal: ack. continuing to full incremental rollout to 25% if metrics stable at 10m mark.

miguel: canary complete (10m). final: errors 0.009%, p95 208ms. green. Proceeding to 25% rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 25% initiated. Gradual bumping with automated health checks every minute.

sara: notifying CS and Support now. Nina on support: can you prep a KB snippet and quick customer message?

nina: prepping KB snippet and canned reply. Will post to #support-assist and add to status page draft.

miguel: 25% steady for 8m — errors 0.01%, p95 220ms. moving to 60% now per rollout policy.

jamal: good. pinning version 2.3.1-hotfix for 24h to ensure rollback window if any latent issues.

ellie: security retains monitoring; if any unexpected auth logs spike, escalate immediately.

miguel: full rollout complete at 23:58 UTC. Post-rollout summary: errors 0.011% (below threshold), p95 225ms, CPU normal. No rollbacks.

sara: product confirms no user-facing regressions in telemetry. We'll publish a short release note and a support advisory.

jamal: release note to be filed: "Hotfix: address intermittent auth token expiry causing failed refreshes. Rolled out as 2.3.1-hotfix on 2025-11-16 23:58 UTC. Pinned for 24h. No DB changes."

nina: KB and support message posted to #support-assist. Customer-facing blurb ready for ops to publish.

miguel: keeping extra monitoring and a runbook on standby for the 24h pin window. If stable, we'll unpin and include the hotfix in next minor.

jamal: thanks everyone — closing thread. If anyone sees anomalies, reopen or @jamal. :rocket:
